guaranteeScope: Package compatibility guarantees archive layout, manifest placement, and byte integrity. Runtime compatibility remains conditional on each skill's declared tools, authentication, network, and data requirements.

standaloneZip.layout: One top-level {name}/ directory containing SKILL.md and the complete canonical skill.

standaloneSkill.layout: Byte-identical ZIP payload to standaloneZip with the .skill extension.

skills.name: advisor-review
skills.notes: The package can be uploaded anywhere that accepts the archive layout, but the nested local Codex CLI process cannot run in a web-only skill sandbox.

skills.name: agent-finish-line
requirements: tools needed to complete the user's target action
skills.notes: The skill is instruction-only and creates no contract, receipt, gate, backlog, or attempt-tracking artifacts unless the user explicitly requests a formal record.

skills.name: katok-reply-reuse
requirements: macOS KakaoTalk archive authorized by the user
skills.notes: A web-only runtime cannot access the user's local authorized KakaoTalk archive.

skills.name: learnus-course-copilot
skills.notes: The skill deliberately depends on an existing local browser login and does not accept copied credentials or cookies.

skills.name: quant-stock-polling-trader
requirements: KIS Open API credentials for the selected paper or live scope
outbound access to the selected broker API
secure local secret injection or a permission-0600 dotenv fallback
frozen screen, account, exposure, calendar, risk, and execution-policy inputs
systemd for generated Linux user units
skills.notes: The daily KIS live/shadow pipeline is a direct prepare, snapshot/plan, entry, and reconciliation flow with API mutations fixed to zero. Daily preparation starts at 01:00 in each market timezone to leave a measured multi-hour refresh window, while initial multi-year bootstrap remains a separate prerequisite. Optional ntfy completion/block notifications read only a protected topic URL/token and cannot alter the worker result. The workflow does not require approved source digests, provenance signatures, account-identity HMACs, trading-arm artifacts, or Toss/NH files.

skills.name: quant-stock-technical
requirements: user-provided finalized OHLCV and benchmark files, or KIS Open API credentials for read-only Korean and U.S. EOD acquisition
outbound KRX, Nasdaq Trader, KIS, and benchmark source access
skills.notes: The Korean and U.S. EOD collectors are resumable and read-only. Complete byte-equivalent cache files are no longer rewritten, while changed, incomplete, or invalid files still update atomically. Normalized source descriptors are projected back to the exact manifest build-spec schema. KIS interior adjusted rows with invalid OHLC geometry are source-hashed and excluded without interpolation, while an invalid cutoff still blocks.

skills.name: stock-scenario-story
skills.notes: The skill is never standalone at runtime even though its upload archive is standalone.

skills.name: yonsei-central-student-governance-counsel

web or browser fallback for changed or blocked sources
skills.notes: The packaged corpus is self-contained, but current-rule advice requires live source-lineage checks.
